I remember myself watching the old videos when I am eating lunch or dinner just to have a really good meal. They really helped me on days when the lunch or the dinner was not my liking. What I admired most was the price point comparison videos and videos where the budget would be around 500-1000 so that I can actually consider going there. The honest review videos, the controversy videos, the genuine down to earth videos made you special in everyone's eyes, if not then at least to me. And watching this video felt like a flashback of how far I have come. I shifted from college to University, from living in Jashore to shifting to Dhaka for studies to switching into job life, everything felt like a passing stream along with the videos I watched here. So yeah, kudos for making this video. Perhaps this is the best video I have watched after a very long time. Data: That was Pulao Kabab native to Rawalpindi, It's hard to find good Biryani in Rawalpindi-Islamabad.
